description: Generate a complete `item` document (form of `value`) with summary and metadata elements. JSON outline here is useful, but any details in prompt instructions should override.
name: createValue

backgrounds.description: Background Influences (ethical, ideological, philosophical, etc.) related to `value`

content.description: Include entire, or snippets, original Member conversation regarding this `value`

conviction.description: Conviction level of `stance` from 0-10, where 0 is no conviction and 10 is full conviction

emotional_intensity.description: Emotional intensity level of `stance` from 0-10, where 0 is no emotional intensity and 10 is high emotional intensity

form.description: MyLife System Form of `value`; political-values bots should use `political` form, all others should use `personal`

keywords.description: Keywords most relevant to `value`, include any relevant ideology, movement, or issue keywords for political values

summary.description: A complete `value` summary composed of all salient points and related points from member content; **note**: This type of summary should include at least the first two parts: 1) What: A summary of the `value` expression itself, 2) Why: Why the member holds this `value` in their life and/or worldview, and 3) How: How the member enacts this `value` in their life, or stories thereof (optional)

title.description: Generate display Title for `value` based on content
